verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is a government foreigner-registration and visa e-services portal for submitting applications. User-defined event-triggered automation rules fall outside what this kind of product does, so the axis is a category error. The evidence is only front-door probes and does not show any such capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
